battle.name: 鏈路
battle.brief: 察打無人機與火箭砲並存，數據鏈斷了，無人機就是航模，核威懾不在這一關的傷害裡。這場二〇二二年開打的戰爭，裝甲對射只是表面，真正決定戰線推移的是情報衛星、巡飛彈與火力單位之間的連接。

kit.name: T-72
kit.history: 大量生產的主戰戰車。自動裝彈機省下一個人，也讓車體內的彈藥成為被擊穿後的風險。

countries: 這場在節點上叫作「鏈路」的現代戰爭，對應的是二〇二二年二月二十四日開始的俄羅斯對烏克蘭全面軍事行動。交戰方不是兩個對稱的國家，而是三套並行的指揮體系。俄方由武裝力量總參謀部統籌，作戰上分西北、西南、南部與東部四個集群，地面主力是坦克師、摩托化步兵師與空降兵部隊編成的合成集團軍；白俄羅斯派遣的維特貝斯克第115機動作戰旅於二月二十四日進入烏克蘭北部作戰，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩地的民兵武裝則編入俄軍集群。烏方由武裝力量總參謀部下轄的北、東、南等作戰指揮部與各守備部隊指揮，地面部隊在二〇二二年春季重整，與烏克蘭國民警衛隊、地方防衛民兵一同構成防禦縱深。西方援助由北約盟軍最高指揮部歐洲聯合部隊與多國組成的國際特遣隊協調，分批交付的戰車、火砲與防空系統需要數週到數月才完成受訓與前送，因此前線的火力節奏長期由情報與目標數據決定，而不只看彈藥存量。
countriesEn: This modern war, labelled "Link" in the node list, corresponds to the full-scale Russian military action against Ukraine that began on 24 February 2022. The belligerents are not two symmetrical states but three parallel command systems. On the Russian side the operation is directed by the General Staff, which divides the front into north-western, south-western, southern and eastern groupings, with the ground effort carried by tank divisions, motorised rifle divisions and airborne units formed into combined-arms armies. Belarus committed the 115th Mechanised Brigade from Vitebsk, which entered northern Ukraine on 24 February, and the militia formations of Donetsk and Luhansk were attached to the Russian groupings. On the Ukrainian side the front is run by the General Staff through the northern, eastern and southern operational commands and the various guard brigades, with the ground troops re-formed in the spring of 2022 and joined by the National Guard and local territorial defence units to form the defensive depth. Western assistance is coordinated by the NATO Joint Force Command Brunssum and by a multinational international task force. The tanks, artillery and air defence systems delivered in batches need weeks or months of training and forward movement, so the tempo of fire on the front line has long been set by intelligence and targeting data rather than by stock levels alone.
people: 俄羅斯方面，總統弗拉基米爾·普京以最高統帥身分在二月二十二日簽署命令，並在二月二十四日宣布「特別軍事行動」，由他決定了這場戰爭以全面入侵的形式展開；國防部長謝伊紐掌管動員、軍費與武器交付，參謀總長格拉西莫夫負責各集群的作戰計畫。戰區層面，南部集群由伊萬·索羅夫采夫指揮，北方集群由安德烈·尤多夫指揮，東部集群與第一坦克集團軍則由其各自指揮官率領沿頓涅茨克方向推進。僱傭兵組織「瓦格納」武裝在二〇二二年春夏成為另一支可用的突擊力量，其指揮人葉夫根尼·普里戈津直接向總統負責，五月打到北頓涅茨克工業區，六月轉戰索萊查爾。烏克蘭方面，總統澤連斯基拒絕任何割讓領土的方案並主持了全國動員，武裝力量總司令瓦勒里·扎盧日尼自二〇二二年起指揮全軍作戰，第92、第93機動作戰旅等部隊在前線長期纏鬥。西方由美國國防部長勞埃德·奧斯汀、駐歐洲美軍指揮官斯圖爾特·麥肯齊與北約秘書長延斯·斯托爾貝格協調援助，美國軍事援助協調員邁克爾·卡彭特負責對接烏方需求，英國與美國的情報機構公開承認向前線提供目標情報。無論是普京的「特別軍事行動」還是澤連斯基的全面抵抗，關鍵決定都落在少數幾個人手上，而前線的成敗則交給數千個不斷被補充又被消耗的基層指揮單位。
peopleEn: On the Russian side, President Vladimir Putin, acting as supreme commander, signed the order on 22 February and announced the "special military operation" on 24 February; it was his decision that the war would take the form of a full-scale invasion. Defence Minister Shoigu handled mobilisation, the budget and weapons deliveries, while Chief of the General Staff Gerasimov drew up the plans for the various groupings. At theatre level the southern grouping was commanded by Ivan Surovcev, the northern grouping by Andrei Yudof, and the eastern grouping and the First Tank Army were led by their own commanders along the Donbas axis. The Wagner private military company became a second usable strike force in the spring and summer of 2022 under Yevgeny Prigozhin, who reported directly to the president, fighting in the North Donbas industrial belt in May and at Soledar in June. On the Ukrainian side, President Zelensky refused every proposal to cede territory and ran the national mobilisation, and Commander-in-Chief Valerii Zaluzhny has directed operations since 2022, with units such as the 92nd and 93rd Assault Brigades locked in prolonged combat at the front. The West coordinated its deliveries through US Defence Secretary Lloyd Austin, the SACEUR Stuart McKenzie and NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg, with the US Security Assistance Group Ukraine under Michael Carpenter matching Western stocks to Ukrainian requests, while British and American intelligence agencies publicly acknowledged providing targeting data to the front line. Whether it was Putin's "special military operation" or Zelensky's total resistance, the decisive choices belonged to a handful of individuals, and the outcome on the front was left to thousands of junior command units that were continuously replenished and continuously spent.
kits: T-72 在這一場戰爭裡同時出現在兩支軍隊的序列中。俄軍的可戰鬥裝甲以 T-72B3 與 T-72B3M 為主，第一批投入的坦克師裝備此型，同時大量老舊 T-72 與 T-72A 從儲備中翻修後上線，側面裝甲薄、缺乏熱像瞄準具的老車與新型號混在同一條補給線上。烏軍同樣保有 T-72B3，二〇二二年三月哈爾科夫的烏克蘭工廠恢復維修產能，前線的烏軍 T-72B3 多數加裝 Kontakt-1 反應裝甲，熱像瞄準具則主要在二〇二一年後才補齊。T-72 用 125 毫米 2A46 滑膛砲配自動裝彈機，車內備彈約二十二發，乘員三人，射速每分鐘兩到三發；車體內堆滿的彈藥意味著一旦被穿甲彈擊穿就極易殉爆，這也是裝甲車必須與步兵、反裝甲小分隊綁定使用的原因。除裝甲外，雙方的火力骨架是火箭砲與牽引砲：9A52「冰雹-S」BM-30 射程約七十至九十公里，BM-21「冰雹」122 毫米約二十公里但精度有限，2S19「元帥」自行榴彈砲約七十公里，2S9「菊花」120 毫米迫擊砲車約十六公里。情報與打擊方面，俄軍大量使用 Orlan-10 組網偵察機、Lancet-3 巡飛彈與 Shahed-136 撞地無人機，烏軍則有 Bayraktar TB2 察打無人機、MQ-9「死神」與 Switchblade 300 巡飛彈，並大量自製 FPV 飛行炸彈與光纖制導飛行器。單兵武器是 AK-74 與 AK-74U 步槍、RPG-7 與 AGS-17 霰彈槍，反裝甲則是 NLAW、AT4、Javelin 與刺針肩射式防空系統，烏軍的 RPG-7VP 常用穿甲彈頭專打 T-72 的側面與後部。防空與電子戰同樣構成體系：9K37「箭」、9K35「箭」、S-300 與 S-400 構成攔截網，俄軍以 Krasukha-2 與 Pole-21 進行電磁反制，烏軍則把 Starlink 衛星寬頻與商用基地台當作偵察與火力引導的骨架。
kitsEn: The T-72 appears in the order of battle of both armies in this war. Russia's combat-ready armour was built around the T-72B3 and T-72B3M, which equipped the tank divisions committed in the first wave, while large numbers of older T-72 and T-72A vehicles were pulled from storage, refurbished and sent forward, so thinly plated models without thermal sights travelled the same supply lines as the new ones. Ukraine also kept the T-72B3; the Kharkiv plant resumed repair output in March 2022, and most Ukrainian T-72B3s at the front carried Kontakt-1 reactive armour, with thermal sights mainly added only after 2021. The T-72 mounts a 125 mm 2A46 smoothbore gun with an autoloader, holds about twenty-two rounds in the hull, carries a crew of three and fires two to three rounds per minute. The ammunition stored inside the hull makes the tank extremely prone to cook-off once penetrated by an anti-tank round, which is why armoured vehicles had to be used in company with infantry and anti-tank teams. Beyond armour, the backbone of fire on both sides was rocket artillery and towed guns: the 9A52 Smerch BM-30 reaches about seventy to ninety kilometres, the 122 mm BM-21 Grad about twenty kilometres with limited accuracy, the 2S19 Msta self-propelled howitzer about seventy kilometres, and the 2S9 Nona 120 mm mortar carrier about sixteen kilometres. For reconnaissance and strike, Russia used large numbers of Orlan-10 meshed surveillance drones, Lancet-3 loitering munitions and Shahed-136 one-way attack drones, while Ukraine fielded Bayraktar TB2 strike drones, MQ-9 Reapers, Switchblade 300 loitering munitions and a large volume of improvised FPV flying bombs and fibre-optic guided craft. Small arms were the AK-74 and AK-74U rifles, RPG-7 launchers and AGS-17 shotguns; anti-tank weapons were NLAW, AT4, Javelin and the Stinger shoulder-launched air defence system, with Ukrainian RPG-7VP warheads commonly using shaped-charge and HEAT-FS rounds against the flanks and rear of T-72s. Air defence and electronic warfare formed their own layer: 9K37 Buk and 9K35 Strela, S-300 and S-400 networks, Russian Krasukha-2 and Pole-21 countermeasure systems, while Ukraine treated Starlink satellite broadband and commercial cell sites as the backbone of reconnaissance and fire control.
tactics: 二〇二二年二月二十四日俄軍自多個方向同時進攻：白俄羅斯方向由第四軍與維特貝斯克旅施壓波羅的海沿岸，北方集群主攻切爾尼戈夫與蘇梅，南方集群沿克里米亞至赫爾松的走廊北進，東部集群向盧甘斯克方向施壓。俄軍的戰法是縱深突進配合摩托化縱隊，裝甲師以營為單位分散行軍，白天行軍夜間發動攻擊，部分縱隊在狹窄道路上拉成數十公里長條，補給線極脆。烏軍三月在北頓涅茨克、四月在伊久明與南烏赫坦斯克組織消耗與撤守，五月北頓涅茨克工業區戰役成為上半年最激烈的城市戰；六月北頓涅茨克與波羅的海斯克淪陷後，烏軍退往北頓涅茨克至頓河羅加內一線，七、八月在東南部發動反攻並奪回部分陣地。俄軍在夏季改以炮兵與火箭砲齊射配合滑翔炸彈空襲的反動型打擊；烏軍則以無人機與小分隊襲擊俄軍後方的橋樑、油料庫與指揮所，七月抵達前線的 HIMARS 火箭砲被用來打擊縱深節點與前線後方的彈藥庫。九月至十月的赫爾松反攻中，烏軍以少量機械化部隊插入敵側翼，步兵與無人機協同推進，奪回赫爾松州西部大片陣地，並在十月下旬收復克里米亞北部。俄軍此後轉入防禦，構築塹壕、佈雷、加設反坦克導線與障礙物，同時以突擊部隊與巡飛彈打擊烏克蘭縱深；烏軍把反攻重點轉向羅加內與克里米亞北部，雙方在頓巴斯陷入消耗。
tacticsEn: On 24 February 2022 Russia attacked along several axes simultaneously: the Belarusian direction, where the 4th Army and the Vitebsk brigade pressed on the Baltic coast; the northern grouping against Chernihiv and Sumy; the southern grouping advancing north along the corridor from Crimea to Kherson; and the eastern grouping pressing toward Luhansk. The Russian method was deep penetration combined with motorised columns: tank divisions moved dispersed at battalion strength, marched by day and attacked at night, and some columns stretched into strings tens of kilometres long on narrow roads, leaving the supply line extremely fragile. Ukraine fought delaying actions at North Donbas in March and at Izium and south-eastern Ukraine in April, and the fighting for the North Donbas industrial belt in May became the fiercest urban battle of the first half of the year. After Severodonetsk and Bakhmut fell in June, the Ukrainian line withdrew to the Severodonetsk–Siverskyi Donets line and counter-attacked in the south-east in July and August. Russia shifted in summer to reactive fire: massed artillery and rocket salvos paired with glide bomb airstrikes. Ukraine struck Russian bridges, fuel depots and command posts behind the line with drones and small teams, and the HIMARS rocket artillery that reached the front in July were used against depth nodes and ammunition depots behind the frontline. In the Kherson counter-offensive of September and October, Ukraine inserted small mechanised groups into the enemy flank, advanced with infantry and drones working together, and recovered large areas of western Kherson oblast, taking back most of northern Crimea in late October. Russia then went over to the defensive, digging trenches, laying mines, adding anti-tank wire and obstacles, and striking deep into Ukraine with assault troops and loitering munitions, while Ukraine shifted the weight of its counter-offensive towards the Donbas and northern Crimea, and both sides settled into a war of attrition.
data: 可查證的數字集中在幾個節點上。開戰時間是二〇二二年二月二十四日。西方公開評估把俄軍當時投入的總兵力放在十五萬至二十萬人之間，地面部隊約佔一半。烏方公布的戰線長度超過一千二百公里，覆蓋頓巴斯、扎波羅熱與赫爾松等州。美國國防部在二〇二二年年底的評估指俄軍全年損失逾十萬人，該數字包含陣亡、負傷與失聯，其中陣亡者達數萬人量級；烏軍的對應損失當時沒有完整公開。開源統計把二〇二二年俄軍各型戰車與裝甲車的摧毀與被俘總數列在數千輛量級，烏軍損失亦有數百輛。射程上，9A52「冰雹-S」與美製 HIMARS 的 GMLRS 導彈同為七十至九十公里，ATACMS 為三百公里，而 125 毫米 2A46 砲配自動裝彈機，車內二十二發備彈、三人乘員、每分鐘兩到三發。赫爾松反攻向前推進最多約六十公里，收復數千平方公里。開支方面，二〇二二年烏克蘭國防開支超過三百億美元，西方軍事援助約在一百億美元量級；俄方直接軍費開支的外部估算則在數百億美元量級。二〇二二年七月末開通的黑海糧食走廊在首年運出約三千萬噸穀物，同期全球小麥與化肥價格升至數十年高位。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers cluster around a few points. The war started on 24 February 2022. Western public assessments placed the total Russian force committed at between 150,000 and 200,000, with roughly half of that on the ground. Ukraine puts the length of the front at more than 1,200 kilometres, covering Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson. A US Department of Defense assessment at the end of 2022 put Russian losses for the year above 100,000, combining killed, wounded and missing, with fatalities in the tens of thousands; no equivalent full Ukrainian figure was published at the time. Open-source tallies put Russian tanks and armoured vehicles destroyed or captured in 2022 in the low thousands of vehicles, with Ukrainian losses in the hundreds. On range, the 9A52 Smerch and the American GMLRS aboard HIMARS both reach seventy to ninety kilometres, ATACMS reaches 300 kilometres, and the 125 mm 2A46 with its autoloader holds twenty-two rounds, carries a crew of three and fires two to three rounds per minute. The Kherson counter-offensive advanced up to about sixty kilometres, recovering several thousand square kilometres. On spending, Ukrainian defence expenditure passed 30 billion US dollars in 2022 with Western military assistance in the region of 10 billion, while external estimates put direct Russian military spending in the tens of billions. The Black Sea grain corridor opened at the end of July 2022 and moved about 30 million tonnes of grain in its first year, during which global wheat and fertiliser prices rose to multi-decade highs.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因可以往回追兩層。表層是二〇一四年二月至三月俄羅斯兼併克里米亞、四月介入頓巴斯並扶植兩個「人民共和國」，烏克蘭的邊境衝突此後從未真正停火。二〇二一年秋開始，烏克蘭情報機構發現俄軍在烏境內集結大批部隊與軍用物資，數量遠超二〇一四年那次部署，數十萬人的集結在烏境內縱深形成可辨識的營區；此時俄羅斯提出的要求是北歐與北美的安全架構不得再向南擴張，並要求烏克蘭放棄加入北約。中間那一年的外交空轉，源於莫斯科對西方承諾的懷疑。俄方在二〇二一年年底嘗試以測試性方式確認北約是否會援引「五點」做出軍事承諾，被華盛頓拒絕；二〇二二年二月十五日北約峰會通過芬蘭與瑞典的加入程序，十六日正式批准，進一步加深了莫斯科的安全焦慮。二月十八日至二十一日，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克共和國宣布獨立並要求承認，俄羅斯於二十一日承認，兩地民兵隨即被整編進俄軍集群。二月二十四日俄軍自多個方向開火，普京宣布「特別軍事行動」，同日澤連斯基要求議會進入戰時狀態，並拒絕任何形式的割地安排。
causeEn: The origins of this war can be traced in two layers. On the surface lie February and March 2014, when Russia annexed Crimea and intervened in the Donbas, establishing the two self-proclaimed republics, after which the armed conflict along Ukraine's frontier never truly stopped. From the autumn of 2021 Ukrainian intelligence detected Russian forces and materiel massing inside Ukraine on a scale far exceeding the 2014 deployment, with several hundred thousand troops forming recognisable barracks in the depth of the country. Moscow's demand was that the European and North American security architecture expand no further south, and that Ukraine abandon its NATO membership. The year of diplomatic deadlock that followed grew out of Moscow's distrust of Western pledges: in late 2021 Moscow probed whether Washington would invoke the Article 5 language with military action, and was refused; on 15 February 2022 the NATO summit approved the accession procedures for Finland and Sweden and formally ratified them the next day, deepening Russian security anxiety. From 18 to 21 February the Donetsk and Luhansk republics declared independence and asked for recognition, Russia recognised them on the 21st, and the local militias were immediately folded into the Russian groupings. On 24 February Russian forces opened fire from several directions and Putin announced the "special military operation"; the same day Zelensky asked parliament for martial law and rejected every arrangement that would cede territory.
impact: 戰爭最深遠的影響落在一套安全架構的重新排列上。二〇二二年五月德國設立一千億歐元的特別基金並在六月修訂基本法，把聯邦國防開支與歐洲共同防務綁在一起；北約同年通過新的北域戰略概念，波蘭、北歐與德國的國防產能同步擴張，芬蘭於二〇二三年四月、瑞典於二〇二三年七月相繼入約。技術層面的改變更為徹底：察打一體無人機、巡飛彈、與火砲的結合從試驗品變成制式配備，Starlink 這類商用衛星通訊第一次成為決定戰役結果的戰略資源，烏克蘭因此被視為無人機戰爭的實驗場。俄軍的應對是電子戰、干擾、反無人機槍砲與更密集的巡飛彈攻擊，雙方的無人機損失節奏都由對方的電磁反制決定。彈藥產能成為另一條戰線，155 毫米炮彈與火箭彈的補充速度決定了火力密度，烏克蘭引進外國廠線組裝，製造能力本身成了戰爭資源。俄羅斯則把戰力轉向北方與其他戰區，在朝鮮、敘利亞與非洲擴張，消耗西方遠程武器的目標累積同樣在增加。全球層面，黑海穀物走廊避免了更壞的糧食危機，但糧價與化肥價格的波動影響了許多進口國家的預算。
impactEn: The war's deepest effects fell on the rearrangement of a security architecture. In May 2022 Germany created a one-hundred-billion-euro special fund and amended its Basic Law in June, tying federal defence spending to a European common defence; NATO adopted a new northern flank strategic concept the same year, Poland, the Nordic countries and Germany expanded defence industrial capacity, and Finland joined in April 2023 with Sweden following in July. The technological change was more thorough still: the pairing of strike drones, loitering munitions and artillery moved from experiment to standard equipment, and commercial satellite communications such as Starlink became a strategic resource capable of deciding a battle, which is why Ukraine came to be treated as a laboratory for drone warfare. Russia's answer was electronic warfare, jamming, anti-drone guns and denser loitering-munition strikes, and on both sides the rate of drone loss was set by the adversary's electromagnetic countermeasures. Ammunition production became a second front, since the resupply rate of 155 mm and rocket ammunition set the density of fire, and Ukraine brought in foreign assembly lines, making manufacturing capacity itself a war resource. Russia meanwhile redirected force to the north and to other theatres, expanding in Korea, Syria and Africa, and the stockpile of targets for Western long-range weapons grew in step. Globally the Black Sea grain corridor headed off a worse food crisis, but swings in grain and fertiliser prices hit the budgets of many importing states.
result: 二〇二二年結束時的態勢是：俄軍控制頓涅茨克州與盧甘斯克州的大部分地區、赫爾松州、扎波羅熱州北部與克里米亞全境，四月至六月間北頓涅茨克、波羅的海斯克等城市相繼淪陷；烏軍的赫爾松反攻在九月發動，十月收復赫爾松州西部並把陣線推回第聶伯羅河下游，十月下旬再收復克里米亞北部多數陣地。北方集群自九月至十一月的基輔州推進有限，到年底大體退回二〇二二年二月原有的界線；烏克蘭守住了首都與主要電力系統。核威懾方面，俄方把核力量置於高度戒備，但沒有使用核武器，西方也沒有以地面部隊直接介入。戰爭由此由一場速決的決戰轉成長期消耗，續入二〇二三年並延續至今。對這個叫作「鏈路」的節點而言，二〇二二年最確切的結論是：決定戰線推移的不是坦克對射，而是情報衛星、巡飛彈、無人機與火力單位之間的連接。俄軍的縱深節點被巡飛彈與無人機清除、前線指揮鏈被反輻射與干擾切斷之後，裝甲部隊的協同與補給同步惡化；烏軍的鏈路靠 Starlink 與大量自製 FPV 維持，代價是自二〇二二年下半年起每月損失數百至上千架飛行器。兩邊都證實了同一件事：鏈路一旦斷了，再好的裝備也會退回成一堆零件。
resultEn: By the end of 2022 Russia held most of Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts, Kherson oblast, northern Zaporizhzhia and all of Crimea, with Severodonetsk and Bakhmut among the cities that fell between April and June. Ukraine's Kherson counter-offensive opened in September, took back western Kherson oblast in October and pushed the line back to the lower Dnieper, then recovered most of northern Crimea's positions in late October. The northern grouping's advance through Kyiv oblast between September and November was limited, and by year's end the front had largely returned to the lines of February 2022; Ukraine held the capital and its main power system. On nuclear deterrence, Russia placed its strategic forces on high alert without using a nuclear weapon, and the West committed no ground forces. The war therefore turned from a short decision battle into a long contest of attrition that carried into 2023 and beyond. For a node called "Link", the most exact conclusion about 2022 is this: what moved the front line was not tank duels but the connection between intelligence satellites, loitering munitions, drones and firing units. Once Russian depth nodes were cleared by loitering munitions and drones and the command chain at the front was cut by counter-radiation and jamming, the coordination and resupply of armoured formations deteriorated with it. Ukraine's link was held together by Starlink and a large volume of improvised FPV craft, at the price of losing hundreds to over a thousand airframes a month from the second half of 2022. Both sides confirmed the same thing: once the link is cut, the best equipment in the world is reduced to a pile of parts.
